## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “2D Stardew farming by day, tower defense at night” game with 3D visuals, suitable for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Check screenshots as JPEGs at no more than 1280px wide; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone Three.js browser game, with day/night cycles, touch-friendly controls, farming, and tower defense.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added game UI, styling, 3D scene, farming actions, night waves, guard towers, and game-over/restart flow.
- Fixed the initial modal button behavior so it can start the game rather than reload it.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/moonflower.jpg`; the scene and HUD render.

### Active
- Finish responsive portrait-camera behavior; initial portrait scaling was just added and needs testing.
- Verify gameplay interactions and fix any issues discovered.

### Blocked
- Browser testing initially reported `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`; a server was subsequently started and the page loaded.
- Earlier browser console showed only a missing `/favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL performance warnings.

## Next Move
